note: jobs and education sit in review_required because Indian topics in both are usually policy questions — the design's own sample ('four-day work week') is filed under JOBS and is squarely policy.
autoPublishNote: While false, promote-topics.js refuses to auto-approve anything and EVERY topic waits for a checkbox in the review issue, regardless of the auto_publish list below. Flip to true only once the pipeline's output quality has been observed for a while — the list is a plan, not a live rule, until then.
escalationNote: An auto_publish topic matching any keyword is promoted to review_required. A cricket topic about a match-fixing arrest must not auto-publish.
